scope: post-hoc diagnosis only; known private teams never fed to bot or prior fitting

trace_audit.limit: Post-hoc truth audit; A/B visit different states/game lengths, so averages are not matched-state causal effects. Move occurrences/decisions correlated; no held-out strength claim or fitting.

block_results.limit: Resamples side/team-swapped seed blocks; shared teams remain dependent. Not a population-strength estimate.

exploratory_mechanism_examples.observed_outcome: Gholdengo used Shadow Ball first and KOed Cinderace before Pyro Ball executed
exploratory_mechanism_examples.interpretation: Shows the downside of a fast-branch tail error, not proof the action was suboptimal under its belief or that this explains the full screen
exploratory_mechanism_examples.independence: 38/39 are mirrored same-seed cases; do not count as two independent mechanisms
